name: Nimble Mount
body:
You help keep your rider out of harm’s way.

Prerequisite: Dodge, trained in riding

Benefit: You grant your rider a +1 dodge bonus to AC and Reflex saving throws. Your rider loses this bonus if you lose your Dexterity bonus to AC for any reason.

Special: This feat may be taken by animals.

Note: Dodge bonuses always stack as long as they are from different sources.
